prompt:
Create ONE original transparent RGBA PNG paper-doll garment/accessory source sheet for ASHVEIL. EXACTLY4 ROWS by8 COLUMNS,32 isolated EMPTY GARMENT OR EQUIPMENT OBJECTS total. No other objects, labels or background. Wide landscape sheet. Every cell has ONE complete empty object and generous truly transparent margins on all sides; no object or strap crosses its cell. Each object fits within about50 percent of cell width and65 percent of cell height. Allow especially wide empty gutters. No connecting pieces across cells, no floor, shadows, glow, haze, particles, dust clouds, checkerboard or text. All blank space is alpha0.

OWN ORIGINAL STYLE: muted gritty ash-gray, brown leather, dull brass, weathered gray scrap metal and dark charcoal chitin. Fine crisp pixel-cluster texture, confident dark stepped outlines, restrained worn realistic materials, proportioned for a compact upright top-down-adjacent RPG paper doll. Neutral upright framing seen from slightly above, consistent scale of a single equipment model across its four views. NOT a pile of unrelated inventory perspective views. No external game references.

CRITICAL CONTENT: ONLY EMPTY CLOTHING AND OBJECTS. NO person, wearer, mannequin, doll, skin, head, face, eye, chest flesh, exposed anatomy, arm, leg, hand or foot. Garment neck/arm openings are empty transparent holes. Hollow garment shells may keep their shape but there is literally nothing inside. Do not fill openings with brown flesh-like shapes. No gore or battle scene. Do not draw weapons; only short arrow-end hints already contained in the requested quiver. These are new empty apparel objects, not an anatomy correction.

DIRECTION IS BY ROW. Every object in one row has the SAME facing. Keep columns fixed:
ROW1 FRONT: front/outward surfaces face the viewer.
ROW2 LEFT: STRICT LEFT-FACING PROFILE. Forward/front edges of a helmet, mask, goggles or breastplate point toward the LEFT of the sheet; rear straps/dripping hems extend to the right. Do NOT face right.
ROW3 RIGHT: STRICT RIGHT-FACING PROFILE. Forward/front edges point toward the RIGHT of the sheet; rear straps/hem extend left. Do NOT duplicate LEFT.
ROW4 BACK: rear/outward surfaces face the viewer, no front features accidentally showing toward the viewer. Show actual reverse/back panels/straps of the SAME objects. A hollow strap loop is not a head.

THE8 COLUMNS LEFT TO RIGHT, identical ordering for all4 rows:
COLUMN1 LEATHER APRON: one worn warm dark-brown leather bib-and-waist apron, empty flat/naturally draped panel from chest to upper thighs, a simple neck strap and waist ties belonging to the same apron. No shirt underneath, no trousers, no sleeves or body. Front bib, thin left/right profiles and actual reverse/apron ties in BACK. All ties remain isolated within this cell.
COLUMN2 OILCLOTH CLOAK: one dull charcoal-gray rain-darkened shoulder cloak ending at upper-thigh height, NO HOOD, NO HEAD, no face, no sleeves or arms. Small empty neck opening at the top, simple shoulder clasp. FRONT has an open front drape and clear gap, LEFT/RIGHT show correct directional drape profiles, BACK has broad continuous rear cape fabric. No other clothing inside it. The cloak is a garment shell only, not a faceless person.
COLUMN3 SCRAP METAL HELMET: one patched dull gray steel protective helmet shell with a short brow/rim, rivets and small asymmetrical repair plates, hollow empty underside. No skull/neck/face, no eyeslits with eyes, no horns. LEFT peak faces left, RIGHT peak right; BACK is the rear helmet surface with no false frontal brim/face.
COLUMN4 CLOTH ASH MASK: one small ash-beige/gray fabric nose-and-mouth dust mask panel with two thin cloth ties/loops, no goggles attached and no head. Front has stitched central fold, LEFT/RIGHT show the forward nose fold toward the correct direction. BACK is its empty inner fabric surface and tie attachment, not a painted mouth.
COLUMN5 BRASS PROTECTIVE GOGGLES: one pair of simple dark round protective lenses in weathered dull brass rims, connecting bridge and brown leather head strap. No face, no helmet, no skin. FRONT shows the pair of lenses, LEFT/RIGHT show the correct profile of near rim and looped strap, BACK prominently shows rear leather strap/buckle and reversed lens cups; do not repeat a frontal pair in BACK.
COLUMN6 LEATHER QUIVER: one narrow brown leather arrow quiver, upright/slightly tilted as a back-mounted object, short shoulder strap within its own cell and only3 short dull arrow-end/fletching hints protruding from the open top, no bow or separate long arrow. Distinct front/reverse seam and left/right edge profiles of the same vessel. No body or weapon held nearby.
COLUMN7 WAIST BELT: one worn brown leather waist belt with a small dull metal rectangular buckle. Empty compact horizontal oval loop, not a straight long strap across the sheet. FRONT has centered buckle, LEFT/RIGHT have buckle edge toward the correct forward direction, BACK shows plain rear leather with buckle hidden/far side. No trousers or hips inside it.
COLUMN8 DARK CHITIN CUIRASS: one empty sleeveless protective chest-to-abdomen cuirass shell made of layered charcoal-brown insect chitin plates with simple leather binding at edges. The empty neck and armholes are clear. Front has overlapping chest/abdomen panels, LEFT/RIGHT are thinner side profiles facing correctly, BACK is an actual layered backplate rather than the front breastplate again. No arms, thighs, skin, animal, claws or horns. No realistic exposed biological anatomy; these are dry armor plates.

All32 objects are independently usable transparent garment sources. Maintain original material identity across each column and explicit row direction across each row. Never draw a wearer or stitch different cells together. Generous transparent margins and full silhouettes are more important than making objects large. No text or frames.
